lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters located posterior to the gill slits. Centroids exhibit regular vertical spacing of roughly 10-15% of the visible flank height.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity (luminance high on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge) run parallel across the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately eight high-luminance spots of varying sizes, primarily concentrated in the central and lower-anterior regions of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; irregular pale scarring is present on the lower flank immediately posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (likely Remora sp.) visible near the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin and along the lower lateral line.
